This proves a legal real-input player strategy, not the original automatic preview animation's exact phase timing.

A same-cell drag first verifies the original guide equals the recorded drop. If its real support moves during released settling, final placement is checked against that production Motion.Target (original support transform+4.2), with both recorded destination and dynamic target logged. No actor coordinates, switches, collision tolerance or water target standards are changed.

Recovery.MoveCount counts successful undoable transactions, including a legal same-cell pickup/release. The original game has no visible player MoveCount field; this internal recovery counter is not presented as native UI scoring.
